title: Active Learning for Calibrating Entangling Gates via Surrogate-Based Optimization
summary: The fidelity of a quantum gate is sensitive to small deviations in the physical control parameters. Unfortunately, it is generally difficult to exactly model the implemented Hamiltonian for a set of user-defined parameters, necessitating on-device calibration. Here, we present an active learning framework based on Bayesian optimization with a Gaussian Process surrogate to find the optimal parameter set.
